name: The Theorist
description: The Theorist is a fragmented, clinical part of Jace Beleren, an amalgamation of his worse traits, who built the Echoverse and plans to overwrite the Multiverse.

summary.text: The Theorist is a fragmented, clinical part of Jace Beleren, an amalgamation of his worse traits, who built the Echoverse and plans to overwrite the Multiverse.

bio.text: Jace's most stubborn self carved away the parts of himself that disagreed, leaving only the Theorist, who excises persons and events from planes' histories to build the Echoverse.
He made Tam, shaping her through a mirror spell in a pocket plane from a wisp of himself, and teaches her, though he cannot remember why he made her.
He planned for Jadzi to die so he could follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse, but he failed to kill her himself.
When Vraska and her allies confronted him, he wiped their memories repeatedly and finally realized he could simply command them, disabling Chandra, Garruk and Ajani.
After Jadzi cut her own throat, he gained cosmic knowledge and began weaving the two Multiverses together.
Liliana tried to talk him down, and Vraska stabbed him in the heart while the aberrations rushed into his mind and overtook it.

status.text: The latest events show the Theorist stabbed in the heart by Vraska and his mind overtaken by the aberrations, while a later page says a slice of Jace's personality took over after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm.

timeline.summary: Jace's most stubborn self carves away the parts of himself that disagree, starting with the honest piece.
timeline.quote: He's even gone so far as to carve out the parts of himself that disagree with what he's done.

timeline.summary: Only the Theorist remains, erasing memories and puppeteering enemies without regard for free will.
timeline.quote: Now, the Theorist is all that remains

timeline.summary: The Theorist calculates probabilities and excises persons or events from planes' histories to build the Echoverse.
timeline.quote: the Theorist calculates probabilities and works to excise elements (a person, an event) from a plane's history.

timeline.summary: The Theorist plans to lay the Echoverse over the existing Multiverse by studying the creation of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The only way to give it stability is to lay its skin atop the bones of the existing Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Harmonious mana on the Theorist's Arcavios creates five elder sphinxes and unified schools.
timeline.quote: harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes and inspiring schools that held unified perspectives.

timeline.summary: The Theorist takes up residence in Hexhaven's bell tower, warping the campus into the tower.
timeline.quote: He took up residence in the central bell tower

timeline.summary: His magic leaves a wasteland, the Eradia, around the tower.
timeline.quote: the Theorist's reality-bending magic left a wasteland surrounding it for nearly a hundred miles

timeline.summary: The Theorist interrupts the guide, silencing the narrator and ordering the reader to forget.
timeline.quote: You will forget what you have heard.

timeline.summary: Tam is made and wakes to find an exhausted man who tells her that her name is Tamira but who she is is up to her.
timeline.quote: "Your name is Tamira, but who you are is up to you."

timeline.summary: He tells her she is a person in progress.
timeline.quote: "In progress. Yeah. You're a person in progress."

timeline.summary: Tam bursts into the sanctum to find the Theorist fighting a masked boy, who wounds him; the Theorist hurls the boy through a portal.
timeline.quote: the Theorist summons a portal—a great round one, rimmed with metal—and hurls the boy into it.

timeline.summary: The Theorist explains that excising aberrations stabilizes the Multiverse spell, and that now he is wholly one thing.
timeline.quote: "Yes. Now that I am wholly one thing, I know exactly who I am."

timeline.summary: The Theorist reveals he plans to overwrite the existing Multiverse by laying the Echoverse over it.
timeline.quote: "Correct. We need to overwrite the existing Multiverse to make this one stable."

timeline.summary: He reveals that Jadzi must die so he can follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "Oh, yes. It's the only way for the phenomenon to be observed.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind and reassures her, and she finds a textbook with Jace Beleren's name in it.
timeline.quote: JACE BELEREN is scrawled in a child's hand in the upper-left corner.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tam found the Theorist's earlier self lost in a vision of Phyrexia's attack on Vryn.
timeline.quote: She knows without doubt that this was Vryn under Phyrexian attack

timeline.summary: Flashback: the Theorist carves the first aberration out of his mind and kicks it through a portal.
timeline.quote: Tam's maker suddenly ripped open a portal and kicked him through with full force.

timeline.summary: Tam telepathically tells the Theorist that he used her to bring Jadzi to her death, and he admits he carved away the part that knew why he made her.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure. I carved the one that knew away.

timeline.summary: Tam confronts the Theorist with her feelings; he silences her with a command and then hugs her.
timeline.quote: The Theorist flinches, lip curling like he slugged back a bitter liquor.

timeline.summary: The Theorist tells Tam to purge herself of doubt as he does.
timeline.quote: "Then purge yourself of doubt," he says

timeline.summary: The Theorist sends Tam to Innistrad through an Omenpath to record its planar data.
timeline.quote: "Go to Innistrad. I need its planar dimensions, including extraplanetary bodies.

timeline.summary: The Theorist goes to Jadzi's cell intending to kill her himself.
timeline.quote: Jadzi, the oracle, awaits with a straight back and a combative glare.

timeline.summary: He dives into Jadzi's mind and drowns in countless possible futures.
timeline.quote: The Theorist's eyes burn bright. He dives into the oracle's mind and crashes into an absolute mess.

timeline.summary: Jadzi sees his future and the Theorist lowers his hand, failing to kill her.
timeline.quote: The Theorist sees in Jadzi's mind a single image—himself, dropping his hand—and she sees him see it in turn.

timeline.summary: Jadzi taunts him and he storms out.
timeline.quote: The Theorist turns, embarrassed, furious, and slams the cell door behind him.

timeline.summary: The Theorist visits the Guildpact for counsel and has him check his proofs, which show the overlay is collapsing.
timeline.quote: "It's collapsing," concludes the Guildpact.

timeline.summary: The Theorist reveals that he stores the Multiverse map in the Theorix cadets.
timeline.quote: "No, in the cadets."

timeline.summary: The Guildpact calls the Theorist a machine that can't even kill one oracle and warns he intends to overwrite their home; the Theorist puts him to sleep.
timeline.quote: The Theorist flicks a hand, and the Guildpact collapses to the rubble with a sick thud, dead asleep.

timeline.summary: The false Liliana heals herself, reveals she will tell the Theorist and runs off.
timeline.quote: "Now, if you'll excuse me, the Theorist needs to know you're here, and uncooperative,"

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies burst into the sanctum and Garruk, Chandra and Ajani collapse asleep at the Theorist's snap while Vraska stays standing.
timeline.quote: The four of them burst into his sanctum, and half a second later, three hit the floor.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks the Theorist to stop and gives him the horseshoe from his mother, which he drops, recalling the illusion of his childhood horse Pewter.
timeline.quote: how in the dark of night the child that was Jace snuck down and created a copy of Pewter to love with his whole heart.

timeline.summary: The Theorist insists he cannot be stopped, and Vraska asks how many will die.
timeline.quote: "How many will die, Jace?"

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him he is a killer who will murder billions, and he wipes her memory and sends the four out.
timeline.quote: her memory of the last few minutes is resting in the Theorist's hand.

timeline.summary: On the second attempt the Theorist freezes the group and shares a memory of how he rebuilt himself after dying.
timeline.quote: It is the day after he died. He is now they, and they have shattered.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Jace shapes a body from the Meditation Realm, imitating Ugin, and pours his fractured selves into it.
timeline.quote: shaping a body from the inherent power of this place and pouring his fractured selves inside.

timeline.summary: Jace creates a pocket plane and uses a mirror spell to make a person, Tam, from a wisp of himself.
timeline.quote: A person, or rather a person-shaped miasma of blue, emerges.

timeline.summary: The Theorist cannot remember why he made Tam, saying only that she is important and must be protected, and wipes their memories again.
timeline.quote: I made a person, but this part of me does not remember why. She must be protected.

timeline.summary: On the third attempt Vraska says he will not convince them, and the Theorist realizes he can command them instead.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to convince you, " he commands, dark and gentle.

timeline.summary: He orders the others to stop each other, and they fight until he calls it off.
timeline.quote: "Stop the others from stopping me."

timeline.summary: The Theorist disables Chandra's decision-making, ruins Garruk's muscles and steals Ajani's language.
timeline.quote: The Theorist reaches inside Ajani's mind and snatches away an entire language.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him she hates what he has become, and he sends her to sleep and wipes their minds, leaving only the knowledge that he cannot be defeated.
timeline.quote: I cannot be defeated by you.

timeline.summary: Tam goes to the Theorist and asks where the Echoverse versions of her friends are; he says they were skipped or removed.
timeline.quote: "They're not here. The process of creation is autonomous. Some things are likely to be skipped. Or removed. It's bound to happen."

timeline.summary: The Theorist reads Tam's mind, learns she met Emrakul, and says Emrakul will be eliminated by the overwrite; Tam pushes back angrily.
timeline.quote: But he saw enough. "You spoke to Emrakul."

timeline.summary: The Theorist commands Tam to stop, but she counters his command and says she will no longer help.
timeline.quote: "This experiment has gone too far," she announces. "I won't help you anymore!"

timeline.summary: The Theorist releases another aberration, the Nihilist, who tells Tam she cannot win.
timeline.quote: A thud. Lungs drawing air. A second man lies on the floor.

timeline.summary: The Nihilist says the experiment is tearing the original Multiverse and that their death will mean nothing; he tells Tam to ask for help, and the Theorist kicks him through a portal.
timeline.quote: "Aberration!" snarls the Theorist, and a half-second later he flashes a portal into existence and kicks the Nihilist through it.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Vraska animates a statue of the Theorist that crushes Vraska and Chandra.
timeline.quote: It is Jace as the Theorist, twice as tall as the real one

timeline.summary: The Theorist asks Vraska to give up, but she spits in his face and demands Beleren back, and he throws them into a portal.
timeline.quote: Vraska feels herself being hoisted up then thrown through the portal into a vast and empty space.

timeline.summary: The Detective tells Vraska the Theorist must be stopped and that he must die; Vraska objects.
timeline.quote: The Theorist must be stopped , he says in her mind. I must die.

timeline.summary: Vraska reaches the Guildpact in his prison in a ruined chamber; he warns that the Theorist has Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "The Theorist has Jadzi," the Guildpact warns.

timeline.summary: The Survivor, last aberration, waits on a beach and has been hiding the plan from the Theorist.
timeline.quote: He's been concealing their machinations from the Theorist.

timeline.summary: The Theorist prepares to kill the oracle on the tower balcony as mage hunters circle below.
timeline.quote: He stands on the balcony of the tower.

timeline.summary: The Theorist realizes his sunrise lacks birdsong and the trivial moments that make it matter.
timeline.quote: "There's no birdsong," he says aloud to no one.

timeline.summary: Jadzi taunts the Theorist; he enters her mind and learns he must kill her, but he cannot muster the courage.
timeline.quote: But he cannot muster the courage to kill.

timeline.summary: Jadzi seizes the knife and cuts her own throat, telling the Theorist to keep his lids open.
timeline.quote: as she cleanly slices the knife across her throat.

timeline.summary: Jadzi's death hurls the Theorist back to the creation of Arcavios, where he sees two planes merging into one.
timeline.quote: when an oracle of Arcavios dies, they are hurled back to the creation of Arcavios

timeline.summary: The Theorist gains cosmic knowledge of how to overwrite the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: I know how to overwrite the Multiverse

timeline.summary: The aberrations attack the Theorist's mind; the Warden and the Clean Slate try to stop him, but he raises a barrier of sleep.
timeline.quote: The Theorist summons a barrier of sleep behind him

timeline.summary: The Theorist begins merging the Multiverses, weaving the new over the old.
timeline.quote: dragging that great fabric over the hard stone of the old Multiverse.

timeline.summary: The Theorist fends off assaults from the aberrations, including sleep, seizures and plague, and overpowers them.
timeline.quote: The Theorist fends off sleep, a seizure, hallucinations of Azor

timeline.summary: The aberrations vanish from his mind and the heroes rush him, but he freezes them in place.
timeline.quote: The heroes rush the Theorist. Without a second thought, he flicks his hand, and his friends come to a halt, standing perfectly still.

timeline.summary: The Theorist summons portals and his friends' doubles tackle them into the portals, then he weaves the two Multiverses together.
timeline.quote: Each tackles their twin into a different portal.

timeline.summary: The Theorist achieves omniscience and the two Multiverses are woven together.
timeline.quote: he weaves two Multiverses together.

timeline.summary: Tam realizes the Theorist taught her everything except how to separate the planes once combined, and tries to push against the Echoverse's seam.
timeline.quote: He knows how two planes combined … but not how to separate them once the process begins.

timeline.summary: The Theorist continues the overlay, weaving both Multiverses together while losing his memories.
timeline.quote: but he's losing himself, thread by thread.

timeline.summary: The Theorist commands his doppelgangers to kill anyone who tries to stop the overlay and aligns his mage-rings.
timeline.quote: Kill anyone who attempts to stop the overlay.

timeline.summary: Liliana and the lich of Professor Opal interrupt the Theorist's omniscience and try to talk him down.
timeline.quote: and he sees in front of him Liliana, Professor Opal at her side as a lich.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells the Theorist she was once him and knows power brings emptiness; he calls her a manipulative snake.
timeline.quote: "Because I was you! I betrayed my allies and I betrayed myself and all I won was loneliness!"

timeline.summary: The Echoverse's Vraska arrives and the lich tackles and kicks the Theorist, forcing him to unleash his mind.
timeline.quote: the lich kicks him in the head.

timeline.summary: The Theorist attacks Liliana's mind with her worst memories, but her double heals her.
timeline.quote: He drowns her heart in the image of himself failing to stop Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Vraska, in her double's disguise, stabs the Theorist in the heart with a knife while Chandra, Ajani and Garruk emerge from a portal.
timeline.quote: Something sharp pierces the Theorist's heart, and he gasps.

timeline.summary: The aberrations rush into the Theorist and overtake his mind, each taking a role in subduing him.
timeline.quote: They overtake his mind like a tsunami.

timeline.summary: Jace's mind fractures after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm, and the Theorist takes over.
timeline.quote: Jace's mind fractured after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm.

relations.quote: To create a Multiverse free of pain and suffering

relations.quote: I was the first. I was the part that was honest about who we are.

relations.note: The Theorist is a fragmented amalgamation of Jace's worse traits.
relations.quote: an amalgamation of our worse traits magnified, without any of the empathy that made us a leader

relations.note: The Theorist made Tam as an artificial being.
relations.quote: I'm a mage who made you for an incredibly special purpose

relations.note: The Theorist made the Echoverse, his grand project.
relations.quote: The Theorist did such a magnificent job of replicating the Multiverse he came from while clipping away its cruelties.

relations.note: He teaches Tam praestigial theory and telepathy.
relations.quote: The Theorist is a wonderful teacher.

relations.note: Tam carries out missions for her maker.
relations.quote: Your duty is to your maker.

relations.note: Opal watches over the captives and helps maintain the hexes.
relations.quote: alongside magic from the Theorist and Professor Opal

relations.note: The Theorist is a part of Jace, not all of him.
relations.quote: The Theorist is the man who made her, but not all of him.

relations.note: Jace created Tam as a person with his chin, stance and talents.
relations.quote: so much of her is just him

relations.note: He calls her Tamira and teaches her.
relations.quote: We are scientists , Tamira.

relations.note: The two are close colleagues.
relations.quote: The two are close colleagues.

relations.note: The Guildpact hates the Theorist and argues with him.
relations.quote: He hates the Theorist.

relations.note: Opal tells the allies she must inform the Theorist.
relations.quote: the Theorist needs to know you're here

relations.note: Jace made Tam through a mirror spell in a pocket plane.
relations.quote: He pulls it out of the mirror, gasping with effort

relations.note: Vraska calls him a monster and says she hates what he became.
relations.quote: "You are the worst part of the best man,"

relations.note: He disables Garruk's muscles.
relations.quote: The druid's axe clatters to the ground, his fingers too weak to hold it.

relations.note: She calls herself the Theorist's architect and rides his statue.
relations.quote: I'm not his lover, I'm his architect.

relations.note: Tam resolves to stop and betray the worst part of her maker.
relations.quote: "I won't help you anymore!"

relations.note: She stays near the Theorist and brings the oracle at his command.
relations.quote: This Vraska ducks inside, and the Theorist turns back to the horizon.

relations.note: She taunts him and kills herself to make his plan harder.
relations.quote: "You really are chickenshit without the rest of you.

relations.note: Ajani accuses him of merging the Multiverses to prove it could be done.
relations.quote: "You did it to prove it could be done!" Ajani snarls.

relations.note: The Theorist taught Tam everything he knew.
relations.quote: The Theorist taught her everything he knew

relations.note: The Echoverse's Vraska steps through and moves to his side.
relations.quote: this Multiverse's Vraska steps through.

relations.note: Garruk works as the Theorist's assassin.
relations.quote: Garruk leaves a trail of blood and death as he helps the Theorist cleave away the troublesome elements of this new Multiverse.

relations.note: She embraces his vision.
relations.quote: Chandra has embraced the Theorist's meticulous vision for all of reality.

pages_say.description: A fragmented version of Jace, an amalgamation of his worst traits, who builds the Echoverse from his sanctum in the tower and erases dissent.
A clinical fragment of Jace Beleren who rules the Echoverse from his sanctum, excising his own aberrations, and plans to overwrite the original Multiverse.
A fragmented, clinical version of Jace who runs the Echoverse from his sanctum and tries to kill Jadzi but fails.
A fragmented, clinical version of Jace who stores the Multiverse map in Theorix cadets and storms away from the Guildpact.
The clinical version of Jace who rules the Echoverse and whom Tam consults.
The clinical remnant of Jace, a utilitarian academic who beats his old friends with mind magic and finally learns he can simply command them.
The clinical remnant of Jace who commands the Echoverse, defeats Tam's friends and sheds another aberration.
The out-of-control part of Jace whose spell is overtaking the original Multiverse and who must be stopped by killing his body.
The part of Jace who pursues the plan to merge the Multiverses, achieves omniscience after Jadzi's death.
The part of Jace who weaves the two Multiverses together with his mind, losing his memories as he works, until the aberrations overtake him.
The part of Jace who merged the Multiverses; Tam knows in her heart he is dead.
A slice of Jace's fractured personality that took over after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm, locking away his empathy and wisdom and monitoring the final step of his plan.
